summary.result: The change of annual total precipitation was not clear, but the southern part of Korea showed an increasing trend (Jeju(+206.4 mm/40years)), and the central part of Korea showed a decreasing trend (Chungnam (-119.6mm/40years)).
summary.background: The changes in the trends of monthly temperature variabilitiy differed by season; March (Gangwon (+0.1℃/40years) ~ Seoul (+3.6℃/40years)) and August (Jeju (-0.9℃/40 years) ~ Chungbuk (+2.9℃/40 years)) showed increasing trends due to the greater increase in maximum monthly temperatures.
summary.method: The trend of annual temperature variability was negative in central Korea (Gyeonggi (-4.2℃/40 years)) and positive in southern Korea (Gyeongnam (+1.0℃ /40years)).
